integrity: The proof is supported by an exhaustive face enumeration, a complete Hasse-diagram acyclicity check for the stated matching, and an independent mod-2 boundary-rank computation. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is for the ordinary Morse complex of the triangular prism only; it does not classify prism graphs or cubic graphs in general. Terminological overlap with directed-tree and rooted-forest complexes leaves a residual literature risk despite targeted searches.
title: The triangular-prism Morse complex is a wedge of sixty-four four-spheres
